title: Generate native 30-second videos in a single Seedance 2.5 generation for…
content:
Generate native 30-second videos in a single Seedance 2.5 generation for long-take shots.  
Use Long Video Mode to create consistent videos up to 3 minutes.  
Use the interactive editing tools with precise timestamp control (down to 1 second) to reshape/edit any part of the frame at specific times.  
For larger projects, use up to 50 multimodal references (including 3D white models and green-screen assets) to guide generation and maintain consistency.  
Integrate Seedance 2.5 into film/VFX pipelines using the Dreamina AI Maya and Blender plugins.
